pages.title: Extremophiles
pages.text: $(thing)Extremophiles$()$(br2)Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.

$(thing)Insight$(): 70$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Genomics, Cryogenics, Microbiology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Genome Sample.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A reaction proceeds only when molecules reach a short-lived activated complex at the top of the energy barrier. Treat that complex as in equilibrium with the reactants and let it fall apart at the universal frequency kB·T/h, with a transmission coefficient κ. Write the rate constant in terms of the activation enthalpy and activation entropy (molar).
